description: This file implements a client-side viewer for code diffs, including UI controls, payload parsing, and diff rendering logic.

classes.name: ViewerState
classes.description: Tracks current UI state such as theme, layout, background, and word wrap settings.

classes.name: DiffController
classes.description: Associates a payload with its corresponding FileDiff instance for rendering.

methods.name: parsePayload
methods.description: Parses a DiffViewerPayload from an HTMLScriptElement's text content.

methods.name: getCards
methods.description: Collects all diff card elements and their payloads from the document.

methods.name: ensureShadowRoot
methods.description: Attaches a shadow DOM to a host element if not already present, using a template.

methods.name: getHydrateProps
methods.description: Extracts file diff metadata and file contents from a payload for hydration.

methods.name: createToolbarButton
methods.description: Creates a styled toolbar button with specified icon and click handler.

methods.name: applyToolbarStyles
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to the toolbar container.

methods.name: applyToolbarButtonStyles
methods.description: Applies CSS styles to a toolbar button based on active state.

methods.name: splitIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG markup for the split diff icon.

methods.name: unifiedIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG markup for the unified diff icon.

methods.name: wrapIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG markup for the word wrap toggle icon.

methods.name: backgroundIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG markup for the background highlight toggle icon.

methods.name: themeIcon
methods.description: Returns SVG markup for theme toggle icon based on current theme.

methods.name: createToolbar
methods.description: Constructs the diff viewer toolbar with layout, wrap, background, and theme controls.

methods.name: createRenderOptions
methods.description: Generates diff rendering options based on current UI state and payload options.

methods.name: syncDocumentTheme
methods.description: Updates document body dataset to reflect current theme.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Applies current UI state to a specific diff controller.

methods.name: syncAllControllers
methods.description: Synchronizes UI state across all diff controllers and updates theme.

methods.name: hydrateViewer
methods.description: Initializes diff viewers by processing payloads, preloading highlighters, and rendering diffs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point to hydrate the diff viewer on page load, handling success and errors.
